Namaste, India's homegrown electric 2W brand, Ather, recently unveiled its brand-new scooter, the Ather Konarc. Konarc will be technically their entry-level offering, but the price will start at Rs 1 lakh ex-showroom, and the software pack, Ather Stack Pro, will be a few thousand more.
I got a chance to see both the Ather Konarc S and Konarc Z versions and rode the one that will be delivered to customers this year itself. Here are my impressions.
